summary: Connect ESG goals to program outcomes, risk controls and reporting artefacts. Explore this intermediate five-day course and its applied curriculum.
lede: ESG programme development organizes environmental, social and governance priorities into coordinated initiatives with defined outcomes. For program managers, ESG leads and portfolio professionals, this intermediate course addresses how to turn material topics into governed, measurable program work. You practise prioritizing material topics and mapping outcomes to accountable owners, assessing program risks, and developing indicators and a reporting dashboard using GRI Standards and GHG Protocol data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate ESG commitments across programs, initiatives and reporting functions. It suits an intermediate level, particularly when your work already involves program planning, sustainability priorities or performance reporting.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with program or project planning is expected. Prior ESG reporting experience and coding skills are not required.
